title: Chicken Fajita Skewers
description: A delicious Mexican dish featuring marinated chicken and vegetables grilled to perfection on skewers.

ingredients.name: peruvian
ingredients.amount: 1 teaspoon Peruvian aji amarillo pepper paste

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.amount: 2 large bell peppers (any color), cut into 1-inch pieces

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together aji amarillo pepper paste, olive oil, and minced garlic.
Add the chicken and vegetables to the marinade, and toss to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Thread the marinated chicken and vegetables onto skewers.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Serve the fajita skewers hot, garnished with fresh cilantro and lime wedges.
